Wendy Acheson  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 wendy.acheson@nexatech.in | 📍 Bangalore, India  

Professional Experience / Work History  
At NexaTech Innovations, I spearheaded DevOps initiatives for a product suite handling 15M+ daily active users. Engineered a Kubernetes-based architecture that scaled compute resources by 40% during peak load, reducing infrastructure costs by $250K annually. Designed a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Terraform, cutting deployment times from 2 hours to 15 minutes. Integrated Prometheus and Grafana for end-to-end monitoring, decreasing incident resolution time by 30%. Prior to this, I led DevOps at LumoWorks, where I optimized cloud resource allocation across 12 microservices, achieving 99.95% SLA compliance. At ScaleCube, I automated infrastructure provisioning, eliminating manual configuration tasks for 80% of the team.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed a scalable Kubernetes cluster for a high-traffic e-commerce platform, enabling seamless zero-downtime rollouts and reducing incident frequency by 50%. Built a custom monitoring dashboard with Prometheus and Grafana, providing real-time insights into system health and correlating alerts with user impact metrics. Automated dependency management for a microservices architecture using GitHub Actions, streamlining dependency updates and reducing integration conflicts by 60%. Contributed to an open-source project modernizing legacy application deployments, focusing on CI/CD pipeline optimization and infrastructure-as-code best practices.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Linux administration is central to my workflow, with daily operations spanning container orchestration, service deployment, and system optimization. CI/CD pipelines are my primary focus, with ownership of end-to-end automation for 10+ services, including integration with third-party tools and custom script development. Kubernetes expertise includes managing stateful applications, auto-scaling configurations, and security hardening. Monitoring & alerting systems are critical for maintaining reliability, with deep experience in designing observability frameworks that balance granular metrics with actionable insights. GitHub Actions is a cornerstone of my toolset, enabling rapid feedback loops and consistent deployment patterns. Prometheus/Grafana integration has been pivotal in creating dashboards that align with business KPIs. Terraform is used extensively for IaC, ensuring reproducible environments across dev, staging, and production.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Michigan, 2019.  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate | Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer | Kubernetes Certified Professional (CKS) | Certified DevOps Engineer (CDE)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as NexaTech’s DevOps Innovator of the Year for pioneering a hybrid cloud strategy that reduced migration costs by 35%. Featured in TechCrunch for contributions to open-source CI/CD tooling. Received LumoWorks’ Excellence in Automation Award for streamlining deployment workflows across 12 microservices.
